resources.string: Join your iPhone\'s hotspot to ride
Ready. Rides start in two-wheeler mode.
Not installed. Install Google Maps from the Play Store.
On another Wi-Fi. Join your iPhone\'s Personal Hotspot.
Not connected. Turn on Personal Hotspot on your iPhone, then join it.
Linked. Calls ring over Google Maps.
Shows the song playing on your iPhone, with play/pause and next. Drag it to move it.
One-time permissions, so your iPhone can start rides and ring calls on this phone.
Opens Google Maps when your iPhone sends a place, and shows calls over it.
Stops Android closing Bike Link in the background during a ride.
For your iPhone\'s calls and music.
Pair once, in your iPhone\'s Bluetooth settings.
Ends navigation when you send Stop Ride, and confirms a new destination mid-ride. In the list, open \"Bike Link – Maps helper\" and turn it on.

Ends navigation when you send Stop Ride, and confirms a new destination mid-ride. In the list, open \"Bike Link – Maps helper\" and turn it on. If Android says it\'s a restricted setting: open App info for Bike Link, tap ⋮, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Shows that Bike Link is running.
Lets commands from your iPhone reach this phone over the hotspot.

1. Keep this phone nearby, with Bluetooth on.
2. On your iPhone, open Settings → Bluetooth.
3. Under Other Devices, tap "%1$s".
4. Tap Pair, then allow notifications.

After that, your iPhone reconnects by itself whenever it's nearby.
Enter this once in your iPhone Shortcuts. It makes sure only your iPhone can control this phone.
Join your iPhone\'s hotspot to see this phone\'s address.

Version %1$s

Navigation by the Google Maps app, which Bike Link opens in two-wheeler mode. Calls and music come from your iPhone over Bluetooth, through Apple's accessory services.

Incoming call. Slide to the green end to answer, or the red end to decline.

Taps Google Maps\' \"Close navigation\" button when you send Stop Ride, and \"Yes\" when you send a new destination mid-ride. It only acts for a few seconds after a command from your iPhone, only inside Google Maps, and reads nothing else.
Listening for places, calls and music from your iPhone.
